listing.name: BDS Bismarck
listing.summary: I call it, BISMARCK. 1st grade armor n´ super-durable hull. Avesome maneuverability, speed over 200su, burn 18. Monstrously high flux capacity, 360° shield coverage. 100 fleet points, 5000 ordnance points limit (cca. 6500 with skills affection)
listing.aiSummary: Adds a single, highly durable capital ship with extensive weapon mounts and high fleet points.

description:
I call it, BISMARCK.
- 1st grade armor n´ super-durable hull.
- Avesome maneuverability, speed over 200su, burn 18.
- Monstrously high flux capacity, 360° shield coverage.
- 100 fleet points, 5000 ordnance points limit (cca. 6500 with skills affection)
- Value 19 milion cr.
-17500 cargo, 5000 fuel
-Single flight deck

- Weapon mounts:
74 small universal
30 medium universal
17 large universal
20 medium missile
4 large missile
